description: This file defines a context manager class 'EnableAllLayers' for managing functorch vmap layers in PyTorch, including initializing, enabling, and cleaning up dynamic batching layers and converting batched tensors back to unbatched tensors.

classes.name: EnableAllLayers
classes.description: RAII-style context manager for enabling functorch vmap layers, managing dynamic batching layers, and converting batched tensors to unbatched tensors.

methods.name: __init__(self, levels: list[DimEntry])
methods.description: Initializes and pushes dynamic layers for specified dimension entries.

methods.name: EnableAllLayers __enter__(self)
methods.description: Creates functorch dynamic layers upon entering context.

methods.name: None __exit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any)
methods.description: Cleans up dynamic layers in reverse order upon exiting context.

methods.name: Tensor from_batched(self, batchedtensor: torch.Tensor, has_device: bool)
methods.description: Creates a Tensor object from a batched tensor by unwrapping functorch layers.

methods.name: None inplace_update_layers( self, batchtensor: torch.Tensor, levels: list[DimEntry] )
methods.description: Updates the levels of a batched tensor in place, setting new batching levels.
